Name: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC)
Description: The Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-2:2024 / ECC-1:2018) were developed by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) to set minimum cybersecurity requirements across 4 Main Domains and 28 Subdomains.

Requirements.Name: 1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy
Requirements.Description: A cybersecurity strategy must be defined, documented, and approved by the Authorizing Official.

Requirements.Name: 1-2 Cybersecurity Management & Organization
Requirements.Description: A dedicated cybersecurity function must be established, independent from IT/ICT functions.

Requirements.Name: 1-3 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be defined, approved, implemented, and supported by technical security standards.

Requirements.Name: 1-4 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity organizational structure and roles must be defined without conflict of interest.

Requirements.Name: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity risk management methodology must be implemented across all technology projects and assets.

Requirements.Name: 1-6 Cybersecurity in Project Management
Requirements.Description: Include secure configuration, hardening, and vulnerability assessment before launching projects.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-6 Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management

Requirements.Name: 1-7 Compliance with Laws, Standards, and Regulations
Requirements.Description: Ensure continuous compliance with national cybersecurity regulations and international commitments.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-7 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-8 Periodical Cybersecurity Review and Audit
Requirements.Description: Conduct periodic internal and independent cybersecurity audits and present results to management.

Requirements.Name: 1-9 Cybersecurity in Human Resources
Requirements.Description: Manage cybersecurity requirements and vetting for personnel prior to, during, and after employment.

Requirements.Name: 1-10 Cybersecurity Awareness and Training Program
Requirements.Description: Implement periodic cybersecurity awareness training covering phishing, social media, and mobile devices.

Requirements.Name: 2-1 Asset Management
Requirements.Description: Maintain an accurate, updated inventory of all technology assets and classify them accordingly.

Requirements.Name: 2-2 Identity and Access Management
Requirements.Description: Enforce single-factor/multi-factor authentication, least privilege, PAM, and periodic access reviews.

Requirements.Name: 2-3 Information System & Processing Facilities Protection
Requirements.Description: Protect systems with anti-malware, patch management, restricted external media, and trusted NTP clock synchronization.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-3 Information Systems and Information Processing Facilities Protection

Requirements.Name: 2-4 Email Protection
Requirements.Description: Validate email service domains using SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, with anti-phishing filtering and MFA.

Requirements.Name: 2-5 Networks Security Management
Requirements.Description: Network segmentation, firewall filtering on management ports (SSH 22, RDP 3389), secure browsing, and DDoS protection.

Requirements.Name: 2-6 Mobile Devices Security
Requirements.Description: Encrypt data on mobile devices and BYOD, enforce remote wiping capability, and screen lockouts.

Requirements.Name: 2-7 Data and Information Protection
Requirements.Description: Protect data based on classification level, prevent public access, and enforce HTTPS transit encryption.

Requirements.Name: 2-8 Cryptography
Requirements.Description: Apply National Cryptographic Standards (NCS), secure key lifecycle management, and at-rest/in-transit encryption.

Requirements.Name: 2-9 Backup and Recovery Management
Requirements.Description: Ensure backup coverage of critical assets, fast incident recovery capability, and periodic recovery testing.

Requirements.Name: 2-10 Vulnerabilities Management
Requirements.Description: Conduct periodic vulnerability assessments, severity classification, prompt patching, and subscription to threat bulletins.

Requirements.Name: 2-11 Penetration Testing
Requirements.Description: Conduct periodic penetration tests against internet-facing services, web applications, and network infrastructure.

Requirements.Name: 2-12 Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
Requirements.Description: Collect and monitor cybersecurity event logs in real time via SIEM and retain them for at least 12 months.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-12 Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management

Requirements.Name: 2-13 Cybersecurity Incident and Threat Management
Requirements.Description: Implement incident response plans, threat intelligence integration, and mandatory reporting to the NCA.

Requirements.Name: 2-14 Physical Security
Requirements.Description: Control physical access to data centers, CCTV monitoring, and secure hardware asset disposal.

Requirements.Name: 2-15 Web Application Security
Requirements.Description: Deploy Web Application Firewalls (WAF), multi-tier architectures, HTTPS protocols, and user authentication.

Requirements.Name: 3-1 Business Continuity Management (BCM)
Requirements.Description: Include cybersecurity resilience in business continuity plans, disaster recovery plans, and failover testing.

Requirements.Name: 4-1 Third-Party Cybersecurity
Requirements.Description: Include non-disclosure clauses, incident notification SLAs, and risk assessments in third-party and outsourcing contracts.

Requirements.Name: 4-2 Cloud Computing and Hosting Cybersecurity
Requirements.Description: Classify hosted cloud data, enforce tenant environment separation, and ensure in-country data sovereignty.
